content: परुष {%a.%} [पॄ-उषन्] .²1 Hard, rough, rugged, stiff (<ab>opp.</ab> मृदु or श्लक्ष्ण); परुषं चर्म, परुषा माला <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Harsh, abusive, severe, unkind, cruel, stern (as words); (वाक्) अपरुषा परुषाक्षरमीरिता <ls>R. 9. 8</ls>; <ls>Pt. 1. 50</ls>; said also of a person; स्निग्धे यत् परुषासि <ls>Gīt. 9</ls>; <ls>Y. 1. 310</ls>. .²3 Harsh or disagreeable to the ear (as a sound <ab>&c.</ab>); तेन वज्रपरुषस्वनं धनुः <ls>R. 11. 46</ls>; <ls>Me. 63</ls>. .²4 Rough, coarse, rough to the touch, shaggy (as hair); शुद्धस्नानात् परुषमलकम् <ls>Me. 92</ls>. .²5 Sharp, violent, strong, keen, piercing (wind <ab>&c.</ab>); निर्गच्छतस्तु शक्रस्य परुषः पवनो ववौ <ls>Rām. 7. 28. 28</ls>; परुषपवनवेगोत्क्षिप्तसंशुष्कपर्णः <ls>Ṛs. 1. 22</ls>, <ls n="Ṛs.">2. 28</ls>. .²6 Gross. .²7 Dirty. .²8 Spotted, variegated. .²9 <ab>Ved.</ab> Knotted. .²10 Similar; <ls>L. D. B.</ls> .{@-षम्@} A harsh or abusive speech, abuse.
